analysis: Retrospective CART segmentation and policy-cost sensitivity on the already known UCI card cohort
calibration: Separate regularized logistic mapping of clipped raw log odds; C=1.0, max_iter=2000, random_state=20261010; no constraint on slope
threshold_selection: Minimize FN_ratio * false_negatives + false_positives on policy_validation; lowest threshold wins ties
capacity_ties: Order probability descending, then original source_id ascending; floor(capacity * population)
reporting: Report every declared model, ratio and capacity; no test-driven winner, hyperparameter or cost-ratio selection
scope: This protocol is recorded after the original historical outcomes were public. Reusing their data roles does not create a new untouched holdout. Research error-cost units are not money, lending profit, intervention effects or regulatory compliance. CART is executed in Python, not SAS or CHAID.
